task: Change FreeCAD's unit system to 'Imperial decimal (in, in/s^2)' which corresponds to UserSchema=3. Apply this setting to the user configuration.
task_grounding: FreeCAD is open. Open Edit > Preferences. In the left-hand list, select 'General' and go to the 'Units' tab. In the 'User system' dropdown, select 'Imperial decimal (in, in/s^2)'. (This corresponds to schema index 3 in FreeCAD's settings.) Click OK to close the dialog so the change is written to /home/user/.config/FreeCAD/user.cfg as BaseApp/Preferences/Units/UserSchema=3.

verification.description: User unit schema set to 3 (Imperial decimal)
